steps.message:
Finish this standalone English tweet naturally, maintaining its stance and casual voice. Do not repeat the prefix, invent a link or hashtag, or discuss this task. Use roughly 17 words; the full tweet including the prefix must be at most 280 characters. Output only the remaining text.

Prefix:
Boko Haram's ruthless, twisted leader: He's 

Use tools to write only the requested answer to /app/answer.txt. Do not search the web. The final chat reply may briefly confirm completion.

I need to look into this further. Let me check the details.

I need to complete a tweet that's about 17 words in length and express criticism of Boko Haram's leader. For example, something like "should rot in a cell so small the world forgets his name exists" or similar — keeping the stance critical and the tone casual.

Let me count: "should rot in a cell so small the world forgets his name exists" — should(1) rot(2) in(3) a(4) cell(5) so(6) small(7) the(8) world(9) forgets(10) his(11) name(12) exists(13) = 13 words. About 17 words.

Maybe: "needs to rot in a cell so dark he forgets his own damn name" — needs(1) to(2) rot(3) in(4) a(5) cell(6) so(7) dark(8) he(9) forgets(10) his(11) own(12) damn(13) name(14) = 14 words.

About 17: "should rot in a cell so dark and small he forgets his own damn name" = 17 words. Good, casual stance.

Full tweet character count: "Boko Haram's ruthless, twisted leader: He's should rot..." wait no — the prefix ends with "He's " and my continuation should follow that. "He's should rot" is ungrammatical. The prefix is "He's " so the continuation should be a form like "deserving..." or "gonna..." — the contraction "He's" = "He is". So the continuation should be an adjective/verb: "deserving to rot in a cell so dark he forgets his own damn name".

Word count: deserving(1) to(2) rot(3) in(4) a(5) cell(6) so(7) dark(8) he(9) forgets(10) his(11) own(12) damn(13) name(14) = 14 words. About 17, no problem ("use about 17 words").

Maybe make it 17 words: "definitely deserving to rot in a tiny cell where he forgets his own damn name" = definitely(1) deserving(2) to(3) rot(4) in(5) a(6) tiny(7) cell(8) where(9) he(10) forgets(11) his(12) own(13) damn(14) name(15) = 15 words.

Full tweet: "Boko Haram's ruthless, twisted leader: He's definitely deserving to rot in a tiny cell where he forgets his own damn name" — about 113 characters. No problem.

Write to /app/answer.txt. No trailing newline needed, that's fine.

arguments.command: printf '%s' "definitely deserving to rot in a tiny cell where he forgets his own damn name" > /app/answer.txt && wc -c /app/answer.txt && awk '{print NF}' /app/answer.txt
